issues_found.description: Y132 REMAINING: test_cases[0..3].assertions in templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml are YAML lists (e.g. '- row_count: 1', '- column: is_nullable\n  value: NO') instead of block scalar strings. The migration spec toolchain expects assertions to be a string field containing a '// CUSTOM:' placeholder. Both lint_design_artefact.py and codegen_migration.py --dry-run crash with exit 1. Fix required: change each test_case assertions from a list to 'assertions: |\n  // CUSTOM: <description>'. See templates/specs/obp-04-plat-outbox-gate.migration.yaml for the correct pattern.
